Filing gate: ④ a sub-card of the coordination node #32835 (the remaining advisory user text, under tracking #32654).
Business reason: this follows the parent. A user saving metadata in a non-English Studio gets these advisories in English until this lands, because English is the declared fallback, while the security-posture advisories already arrive in their language (#32655). The readers are AI agent and tool, connector, mapping and sharing-rule authors.
Reader who acts: the `domain:spec` seat dispatches it. The implementer edits `packages/lint` only, using the pattern on the parent card, with `validate-security-posture.user-text.ts` and `finding-user-text.test.ts` as the reference.
Dedupe words: `userTextParams`, `user-text.ts catalog`, plus each rule file's name.

Back-link: #32835 · #32655 · ⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.

## Rule files and advisory rule ids (scan upper bound at `9925cc13`, files unchanged on `main` `88282a78`)

| Rule file | Advisory rule ids |
|---|---|
| `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-agent-authoring.ts` | 3 |
| `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts` | 1 |
| `packages/lint/src/lint-connector-credential-literals.ts` | 1 |
| `packages/lint/src/validate-mapping-connector-source.ts` | 1 |

| `packages/lint/src/validate-sharing-rule-enforceability.ts` | 1 |
| `packages/lint/src/validate-predicate-path-refs.ts` | 1 |
| **Total** | **10** |

Re-measure first. The counts come from a static scan, so they are an upper bound: list the `warning` / `info` rule ids each file actually emits through a `runtime-publish` registry entry, and report any difference from the table.

## Do

1. For each rule file, write `RULE_FILE.user-text.ts` beside it, keyed by the rule's id constants. Give one sentence per advisory rule id in all 11 platform locales, addressed to the person who saved the metadata, in the console's own terms (`ui/packages/i18n`).
2. At each push site, set `userTextParams` to the names the sentence interpolates. Leave rule ids, `message` and `hint` unchanged.
3. Merge the catalogs into `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG` (`finding-user-text.ts`).
4. Add pins in the shape of `finding-user-text.test.ts`: exact catalog coverage (ids × 11 locales); every push site rendered from the rule's real findings in every locale, with no `undefined` and no English stand-in; and one runtime-gate case whose `userMessage` parses under `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema`.

## Not in scope

The save door composing `userMessage` (#32656) and the console rendering it (#32657). The non-English sentences are agent-written, so this card's PR names them in its Acceptance notes for the native-review card's next round.
